source_scope: Curated establishment workbook requested for Cerrillos and Maipú; the supplied source contains one establishment row, located in Maipú.
performance_year_evidence: The workbook does not encode a performance year. The local teaching HTML titled 'Indicadores Hospitalarios SNSS 2025 — Dashboard Docente' declares 2025 hospital statistics and its HEC annual primitives match the workbook exactly. This is secondary curated academic evidence, not the original MINSAL dataset.
source_cut_date_evidence: Declared in the secondary local teaching HTML; not present in the workbook.
created_by_process: Manual deterministic extraction of the single HEC record after source hash, schema, scope, and formula reconciliation.
monthly_source_scope: Twelve HEC-only 2025 observations extracted from a 192-establishment teaching artifact after the user explicitly approved annual plus monthly data.
calculation_policy: Retain primitive counts; recompute all ratios deterministically from summed numerators and denominators; return unavailable for missing values and zero_denominator for invalid denominators; do not compare with simulated 2026 operational data.
geography_policy: Join only by establishment code 111101. Source coordinates are excluded; any map continues to use the packaged validated DEIS reference layer.
privacy_policy: Aggregate establishment-level reference only. Address, telephone, patient identifiers, employee identifiers, and source coordinates are excluded.
limitations: The performance year and source cut date rely on a secondary curated teaching artifact rather than the original upstream MINSAL dataset.
Cerrillos is absent from this source and must never be represented as zero activity or capacity.
The reference supports HEC descriptive inpatient context only; it does not support territorial comparison, ranking, benchmarking, specialty analysis, risk adjustment, prediction, or causal inference.
The reference is visible only to Director and Medical Director roles and is isolated from the simulated operational upload contract.
